title: PR4Code: A Pull Requests Dataset for AI Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.39890v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI-driven code generation is evolving from handling small, localized code-completion tasks toward supporting the implementation of full software features. To support this transition, this paper introduces PR4Code, a dataset of 4,508 Java and 8,831 Python curated Pull Requests (PRs) collected from GitHub, each enriched with metadata, commit histories, and detailed code changes. Unlike resources focused on isolated code fragments, PR4Code captures the feature implementation process, delivering a large and diverse collection of real-world development tasks that can be used to assess AI-driven solutions. Our analysis reveals substantial variability in PR structure, commit granularity, and textual content. In addition, we release scripts to regenerate and update the dataset, ensuring reproducibility and maintainability.

translated_title: PR4Code：一个面向AI代码生成的Pull Request数据集
translated_abstract: AI驱动的代码生成正在从处理小型、局部的代码补全任务向支持完整软件功能实现的方向演进。为支持这一转变，本文提出了PR4Code，这是一个从GitHub收集的精选Pull Request（PR）数据集，包含4,508个Java和8,831个Python的PR，每个PR都附有元数据、提交历史和详细的代码变更。与专注于孤立代码片段的资源不同，PR4Code捕捉了功能实现的完整过程，提供了大量多样化的真实开发任务集合，可用于评估AI驱动的解决方案。我们的分析揭示了PR结构、提交粒度和文本内容方面的显著差异。此外，我们还发布了用于重新生成和更新数据集的脚本，以确保数据集的可重现性和可维护性。
tldr: 本文提出了PR4Code数据集，收录了从GitHub收集的4,508个Java和8,831个Python精选Pull Request（含元数据、提交历史和代码变更），用于在完整软件功能层面支持AI代码生成的研究与评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PR4Code, a curated dataset of 4,508 Java and 8,831 Python Pull Requests from GitHub enriched with metadata, commit histories, and detailed code changes, enabling the evaluation of AI-driven code generation at the full software feature level.
